errors.text_span: Китай/континентален/“ (синя линия) започва около 10,8 през 2013 г. и нараства до около 15,6 през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The description says China starts at 10.8 but the figure shows it starting around 11 million tons and ending at over 16 million tons.
The description says India starts at 2.5 million tons but the figure shows it starting around 2 million tons.
The description states India is around 3.2 million tons in 2022, but the figure shows it is near 2.3 million tons.
The description states Italy starts around 7.8 million tons in 2013, but the figure shows it starting near 8 million tons.
The description does not state the chart is about grape production from all varieties in the leading seven countries.
